name: Black Waves, Greater
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.

This spell functions as lesser black waves except as above and the damage dealt increases to 1d6/CL (max 15d6).

Additionally, the maximum healing to undead increases to 15.
